## About
Bud's started with Bud working on the cars himself. The business grew from there, and you will still find us on Ponce de Leon Blvd in Coral Gables.
Bud hired only people who had a passion for what they did, and that tradition continues today. Customers know Oswaldo, the owner, as warm, honest and easy to talk to.
We handle auto painting, collision repair, lease return touchups, restoration and insurance claims. Neighbors rate us 4.3 from 70 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto painting: Paint work has been at the heart of Bud's since the beginning.
- Accident repair: Body repairs after an accident, with updates along the way.
- Lease return touchups: Touchups to get your car ready before you turn in a lease.
- All insurance companies: We work with all insurance companies.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all insurance companies.

Q: How do I get around while my car is in the shop?
A: There are several car rental places nearby, and one reviewer mentions Enterprise right next door.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call and we will set up a time for you to stop by.
